## doc: rules_of_business_1986.md

Rule 14(1) No department shall, without previous consultation with the Finance Department, authorise any orders which involve expenditure from provincial revenues for a new scheme of development.
---
Rule 17 Every case submitted for the orders of the competent authority shall be routed through the administrative department concerned and shall state the precise point for decision.

## doc: delegation_financial_powers_2019.md

Rule 7(2) The competent authority may sanction expenditure on development schemes up to the limits prescribed in the Second Schedule, subject to availability of budget.
---
Rule 9 Powers of re-appropriation between heads of account shall be exercised by the Administrative Department with the concurrence of the Finance Department.

## doc: manual_development_projects_2019.md

Every development scheme shall be prepared on the prescribed PC-I proforma and shall be processed for approval of the competent forum according to its cost ceiling.
---
The sponsoring agency shall furnish the completion report of every approved scheme on the prescribed PC-IV proforma within the stipulated period.
